newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Leading stocks push down Mauritius share index.
newsitem.headline: Leading stocks push down Mauritius share index.

text.p: The market index at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius (SEM) lost 3.87 points to 364.43 on Wednesday under the weight of falling share prices in leading stocks, brokers said.
Turnover was posted at 10.96 million rupees on 401,951 shares from 13.60 million rupees on 526,293 shares on Monday.
The SEM official market trades on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.

The falling share prices of leading stocks on Wednesday were a correction of the recent market uprun since early December, brokers said. The market index rallied during 17 consecutive sessions and gained 42 points (13 percent) in the process.
"Selling pressures had built up on the leading stocks as a result of the recent market uprun. Today (Wednesday), we have seen that these pressures could no longer be contained," one broker said.
Tourism related stocks were particularly affected by the selling pressures, the broker added.
Hotel based Sun Resorts tumbled by 1.60 rupees to 38.50 on 52,316 shares and national carrier Air Mauritius slumped by 2.30 rupees to 43.90 rupees on 10,405 shares.
In the banking sector, Mauritius Commercial Bank lost one rupee to 83 on 30,200 shares and State Bank of Mauritius remained at 11 rupees on 86,150 shares.

Commerce based Courts slipped by 40 cents to 5.90 rupees on 21,000 shares. Conglomerates Rogers was 50 cents down to 95.50 rupees on 2,500 shares and Ireland Blyth eased by 10 cents to 14.50 rupees on 6,970 shares.
In the investment sector, United Docks was 40 cents lower to 44.60 rupees on 19,452 shares but sugar based Harel Freres was unchanged at 47 rupees on 10,000 shares.
Grand Baie Hotel was 40 cents down to 41 rupees on 11,650 shares and New Mauritius Hotels was stable at 32.40 rupees on 42,265 shares.
